faq.q: What extra checks matter at this price level?

faq.a: Under Surrey's current rules, one secondary suite is permitted in a single family dwelling, capped at 40% of the principal dwelling's habitable area, and a coach house or garden suite runs 35–75 m², up to 120 m² on RA, R2, R2-O and R3 lots where the principal dwelling has not used its maximum floor area; the old 90 m² suite cap is not a current rule.
faq.q: Can an acreage home in South Surrey have a suite or coach house?

faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in South Surrey?
